label: D2 after a rare a2 -> S1 transition
explanation: Fires almost exclusively at D2 on steps where the agent chose a2 but landed in S1 (a rare transition): recall 1.00, mass recall 1.00 on dev, with essentially no activity at D1/GO or on any other action/state combination (never on a1, S2, or common transitions). Precision is only about 0.61, because the unit stays silent on about 40% of rare a2->S1 steps. The firing ones are those where the agent strongly favours a2: adding choice < -4.44 (policy logit at that D2 step) raises F1 to 0.80, and restricting value to a mid range (5.2-7.5) raises it to 0.81. Both are graded model-state gates, so I recorded the simple observed-input predicate. Activation is tiny in absolute terms (max 0.002) and is not clearly modulated by reward or good state (good == 2 trades recall for precision with no gain in F1). Uses only observed inputs (action and reached state are both known at D2).
